title: Distribution and switchgear
summary: Board replacements, sub-mains, LV distribution and metering, planned around buildings that cannot close.
body: Most of our distribution work happens in occupied buildings. We survey the existing installation, map the critical circuits, and phase the changeover so lifts, servers and cold rooms stay on. Temporary supplies are part of the method statement, not an afterthought.
deliverables: Survey and critical-circuit register before any isolation
Phased method statement and temporary supply plan
New boards, submains and metering installed and labelled
Schedule of circuits and updated single-line diagram
